purpose: Record local structural review for all C2-LT-B14 source extraction rows after field-level extraction, confirming required fields, domain ownership files, B14-specific blocked uses, manual/source-resolution route preservation and model-admission blocking before independent fresh review or artifact promotion.

scope.selectionRule: Locally review every C2-LT-B14 source extraction row for required field presence, local domain ownership path, source-route status, blocked-use preservation and model-admission blocking; route HTTP 200 rows only to independent fresh review, and preserve 403/manual-review plus 404/source-resolution rows as blocked before fresh review or artifacts.
currentLimitations: Local review checks structure, route status and blocking semantics only; it does not constitute independent source review.
Twenty-four non-issue rows may only move to independent fresh review and cannot become reviewed artifacts at this stage.
Seven 403/manual-review rows and one 404/source-resolution row remain blocked until source context is manually resolved or downgraded.
No B14 row may feed calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, individual advice, legal/clinical/engineering advice or model admission.
Domain-level claims remain bounded vocabulary and must still pass reviewed Source Card, variable-card, endpoint-card, uncertainty-card and downgrade checks.
